title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
flags: Signal = joint torque (measured on the real robot, predicted inside the world model) as policy input; P = ACT trained on HapticWorld demonstrations
'HapticWorld w/o feedback' (14, 5, 6 of 20) is the method's own ablation that still uses torque; excluded from B under D5. Real-world-data policy is an upper-bound reference, not a baseline
No kind-A row: the vision-only IWS pipeline differs from P in both simulator and policy input, and is an external method (D2b)
Claims sim-real agreement 'within three trials out of twenty' without an interval
